title: Address Bar — Oasis Suggest
description: Learn how to configure Oasis Suggest in the address bar, choose the types of suggestions that appear, and customize your browsing experience with intelligent search recommendations.
content:
Oasis Suggest is an intelligent address bar feature that provides helpful suggestions as you type in the browser's address bar. These suggestions can include bookmarks, browsing history, open tabs, and contextual recommendations to help you navigate the web more efficiently. Understanding how to configure Oasis Suggest allows you to customize your browsing experience and control what types of suggestions appear based on your preferences and privacy needs.

Pro Tip

Oasis Suggest is designed to enhance your browsing efficiency while respecting your privacy. You can customize which types of suggestions appear to match your browsing style and preferences.

What Is Oasis Suggest?

Oasis Suggest is an intelligent suggestion system that appears in the address bar (awesome bar) as you type. It provides contextual recommendations based on:

Local Suggestions

Suggestions from your local browser data:

  • Bookmarks: Your saved bookmarks and folders
  • Browsing History: Previously visited websites
  • Open Tabs: Currently open tabs across all windows
  • Downloaded Files: Files you've downloaded

Enhanced Suggestions

Additional intelligent suggestions:

  • Search Suggestions: Popular search terms and queries
  • Website Recommendations: Suggested websites based on context
  • Spelling Corrections: Corrected URLs and search terms
  • Quick Actions: Browser shortcuts and commands

Types of Oasis Suggest

Local Suggestions

Suggestions from your local browser data:

  • Bookmarks: Your saved bookmarks appear as you type matching URLs or titles
  • History: Previously visited websites that match your search
  • Open Tabs: Currently open tabs across all browser windows
  • Downloads: Recently downloaded files and their locations
  • Form Data: Previously entered form data (with your permission)

Privacy Note: Local suggestions are processed entirely on your device and don't send data to external servers.

Enhanced Suggestions

Intelligent suggestions that enhance your browsing:

  • Search Suggestions: Popular search terms and trending queries
  • Website Recommendations: Suggested websites based on your search
  • Spelling Corrections: Automatic correction of typos in URLs and searches
  • Quick Actions: Browser commands like "new tab" or "private window"
  • Smart Suggestions: Context-aware recommendations

Sponsored Suggestions

Optional sponsored content (can be disabled):

  • Sponsored Links: Relevant sponsored websites and services
  • Product Recommendations: Suggested products and services
  • Brand Suggestions: Brand-related search suggestions
  • Promotional Content: Special offers and promotions

Note: Sponsored suggestions are clearly marked and can be disabled entirely.

Configuring Oasis Suggest

Accessing Settings

To configure Oasis Suggest settings:

  1. Open Oasis Settings (Menu → Settings)
  2. Navigate to the "Search" section
  3. Find "Address Bar" or "Awesome Bar" settings
  4. Look for "Oasis Suggest" or "Address Bar Suggestions"
  5. Click "Settings" or "Customize" to access detailed options

Alternatively, type about:preferences#search in the address bar for direct access.

Suggestion Categories

Choose which types of suggestions to enable:

  • Bookmarks: Show your saved bookmarks in suggestions
  • History: Include browsing history in suggestions
  • Open Tabs: Show currently open tabs in suggestions
  • Search Suggestions: Enable search engine suggestions
  • Enhanced Suggestions: Enable intelligent recommendations
  • Sponsored Suggestions: Show sponsored content (optional)

Privacy Settings

Configure privacy-related suggestion options:

  • Data Collection: Control what data is used for suggestions
  • Location Services: Enable/disable location-based suggestions
  • Personalization: Allow personalized suggestion algorithms
  • Third-party Data: Control use of external data sources

Customizing Suggestion Behavior

Display Preferences

Customize how suggestions appear:

  • Suggestion Count: Choose how many suggestions to show (5-10)
  • Display Order: Set priority for different suggestion types
  • Icons and Formatting: Show/hide suggestion icons and formatting
  • Preview Text: Control how much preview text is shown

Search Engine Integration

Configure search engine suggestions:

  • Default Search Engine: Choose your preferred search engine
  • Multiple Engines: Enable suggestions from multiple search providers
  • Search Suggestions: Enable/disable search term suggestions
  • Auto-complete: Control search term auto-completion

Performance Settings

Optimize suggestion performance:

  • Update Frequency: How often suggestions refresh
  • Cache Settings: Control suggestion caching behavior
  • Network Usage: Limit network requests for suggestions
  • Memory Usage: Control memory usage for suggestion data

Using Oasis Suggest

Basic Usage

How to use Oasis Suggest effectively:

  • Start Typing: Begin typing in the address bar to see suggestions
  • Navigate Suggestions: Use arrow keys to move through suggestions
  • Select Suggestion: Press Enter or click to select a suggestion
  • Ignore Suggestions: Continue typing to ignore suggestions
  • Clear Suggestions: Use Escape key to clear suggestion dropdown

Keyboard Shortcuts

Useful keyboard shortcuts for Oasis Suggest:

  • ↑/↓ Arrows: Navigate through suggestions
  • Enter: Select highlighted suggestion
  • Tab: Complete suggestion text
  • Escape: Clear suggestions and close dropdown
  • Ctrl+L: Focus address bar

Advanced Features

Advanced Oasis Suggest capabilities:

  • Smart Matching: Suggestions match partial text and synonyms
  • Context Awareness: Suggestions adapt to current website context
  • Quick Actions: Execute browser commands from address bar
  • Search Operators: Use special commands for specific searches

Privacy and Data Protection

Local Data

How local suggestion data is handled:

  • Device Storage: Bookmarks and history stored locally
  • No External Sharing: Local data never leaves your device
  • User Control: You control what local data is used
  • Clear Data: Option to clear suggestion-related data

Enhanced Suggestions

Privacy protection for enhanced suggestions:

  • Minimal Data: Only necessary data sent for suggestions
  • Encrypted Transmission: All data encrypted in transit
  • Anonymous Processing: Personal data not used for suggestions
  • Opt-out Options: Can disable enhanced suggestions entirely
Privacy Note

Oasis Suggest is designed with privacy in mind. Local suggestions use only data stored on your device, while enhanced suggestions use minimal, encrypted data transmission. You have full control over what types of suggestions are enabled.

Disabling Oasis Suggest

Complete Disabling

To disable Oasis Suggest entirely:

  1. Open Oasis Settings (Menu → Settings)
  2. Go to the "Search" section
  3. Find "Address Bar" or "Awesome Bar" settings
  4. Locate "Oasis Suggest" options
  5. Disable all suggestion categories
  6. Restart Oasis if prompted

Selective Disabling

Disable specific types of suggestions:

  • Enhanced Suggestions: Disable intelligent recommendations
  • Search Suggestions: Turn off search engine suggestions
  • Sponsored Content: Disable sponsored suggestions
  • History Suggestions: Exclude browsing history from suggestions

Alternative Methods

Other ways to control suggestions:

  • Privacy Mode: Use private browsing to disable suggestions
  • Extensions: Use privacy extensions to block suggestions
    • Search Engine Settings: Modify search engine suggestion settings
  • Browser Commands: Use about:config for advanced settings

Troubleshooting Oasis Suggest

Common Issues

Problems you might encounter with Oasis Suggest:

  • No Suggestions Appearing: Suggestions not showing up in address bar
  • Slow Performance: Suggestions taking too long to load
  • Incorrect Suggestions: Suggestions not matching your input
  • Privacy Concerns: Worries about data collection

Solutions

How to resolve Oasis Suggest issues:

  1. Check Settings: Verify Oasis Suggest is enabled
  2. Clear Cache: Clear browser cache and cookies
  3. Update Browser: Ensure you're using the latest Oasis version
  4. Check Internet Connection: Verify stable internet connection
  5. Reset Settings: Reset Oasis Suggest to default settings
  6. Contact Support: Reach out to Mozilla support if issues persist

Performance Optimization

Optimizing Oasis Suggest performance:

  • Limit Suggestions: Reduce the number of suggestions shown
  • Disable Unused Features: Turn off suggestion types you don't use
  • Clear Old Data: Regularly clear old browsing data
  • Monitor Resource Usage: Watch for performance impact

Best Practices

Privacy Best Practices

Maintaining privacy while using Oasis Suggest:

  • Review Settings Regularly: Check suggestion settings periodically
  • Use Local Suggestions: Prefer local suggestions over enhanced ones
  • Clear Data Regularly: Clear browsing data periodically
  • Monitor Permissions: Check what permissions the feature requires

Usage Best Practices

Getting the most out of Oasis Suggest:

  • Organize Bookmarks: Keep bookmarks organized for better suggestions
  • Use Descriptive Names: Use clear names for bookmarks and history
  • Learn Shortcuts: Master keyboard shortcuts for efficiency
  • Customize Preferences: Adjust settings to match your workflow

Security Considerations

Security best practices for Oasis Suggest:

  • Verify URLs: Always verify URLs before clicking suggestions
  • Use HTTPS: Prefer secure websites in suggestions
  • Report Issues: Report suspicious or malicious suggestions
  • Keep Updated: Keep Oasis updated for security improvements

Additional Resources

For more information about Oasis Suggest and address bar features, we recommend:

Mozilla Firefox Suggest Guide - Official guide from Mozilla

Firefox Awesome Bar Documentation - Complete address bar guide

Address Bar Autocomplete Guide - Autocomplete functionality

Important Disclaimer

This guide discusses Oasis Suggest, which is based on Mozilla's Firefox Suggest technology. The functionality and privacy practices described are specific to Oasis's implementation. Other browsers may have different suggestion systems, privacy policies, and customization options.

Note: Oasis has a version derived from Firefox core, which is why it shares similar address bar suggestion features and can benefit from Mozilla's intelligent suggestion capabilities.
